ache.title: S-tier ‘auto-includes’ and the feeling of a gap
ache.note: From S, ‘auto-includes’, down to D: Nero grades the Genetic Apex and Promo A trainer cards. Honestly, this is one of the gentler posts, mostly about Potion and Professor’s Research. Still, a tier list turns your collection into a gap check: lack an ‘S’ and it feels like you lose before the match starts.
watch: a tier list as a gap check
ache.tip: Build with what you have and see how it plays. A D-tier card you enjoy beats an S you don’t own.
lines: S to D, a report card for paper

videoData.title: [Genetic Apex] Trainer Cards Tierlist | Pokémon TCG Pocket

textData.text: In this episode, I delve into the vital Trainer Cards of the Pokémon Trading Card Game Pocket, including cards from the Genetic Apex and Promo A sets. I'll rank these cards into tiers ranging from S (auto-includes) to D (not good enough), providing insights into their impact on the game. Key discussions include staple cards like Potion and Professor Research, as well as controversial choices like Pokédex and Hand Scope. Finally, I'll recap the complete tier list, sharing my opinions and welcoming your thoughts. Join me, Nero Atlas, as we explore the essentials for building a competitive deck!
